description.component: A slideshow component for cycling through elements images/media or slides of text—like a carousel.

id.name: Carousel ID
id.description: Set a unique id on the carousel for optional controls, especially if you’re using multiple carousels on a single page.

slide_component.name: Slide component
slide_component.description: A component name to render a slide

items.name: Carousel items
items.description: An array of slider items, Each item has (caption, slide, text)

indicators.name: Indicators
indicators.description: Add indicators to the carousel, alongside the previous/next controls.
